sources.title: A Cohomological Viewpoint on Elementary School Arithmetic
sources.enterprise_use: Provides explicit prior art for interpreting elementary carrying through cocycle/cohomological and group-extension language. P018 Supplement 08 uses this only to classify the standard carry defect and its change under section choice before studying Enterprise Math-specific precision transport and operation-scheduling holonomy.
sources.not_claimed: Carrying as a cocycle, the group-extension viewpoint, coboundary change under section choice, and the associated cohomological language are established prior mathematics and are not Enterprise Math inventions.
